decisions.reason: As a newly launched core packaging product with its own webpage, the large bulk container still has unresolved market potential and is worth keeping as a relatively strategic option.
The bulk-container valve is a closely related complement to the container offering, so its own-page presentation and product fit make continued market presence the sensible low-regret choice.

The used packaging take-back service appears less committed because it is only briefly mentioned, but as a low-cost circular-economy option for a large German plastics firm it is still worth keeping for now.
